map.需要转义成 \\|，否则会被当作列分隔符破坏整行结构，这是 Markdown 表:
Escape it as \|, otherwise it is read as a column separator and breaks the whole row — the most common pitfall with Markdown tables. Also note that line breaks inside a cell cannot be expressed directly in standard Markdown; people usually switch to the
tag (though some platforms escape HTML) or split the content into multiple records.
map.行数取输入值并保证在 1 到 50 之间（非法时取 1），列数取输入值并保证在: The row count is clamped to 1–50 (1 when invalid) and the column count to 1–20 (1 when invalid). The header and body seed are split with CSV rules: comma-separated, cells containing commas may be wrapped in double quotes ("" for a literal quote), each item trimmed, leading empty items removed, then truncated to the column count. Cells take seed values in order, using "C" plus the column index as a placeholder when missing, then Markdown escaping is applied: backslashes are doubled first, then pipes are escaped to backslash-pipe, and newlines become spaces, so a pipe in input containing a backslash cannot turn back into a column separator. The separator row uses the chosen alignment: colons on both sides for center, on the right for right-align, otherwise on the left, joined by space-pipe-space. Each body row appends the row number to the seed value, wrapped in pipes with space-pipe-space between cells. The final output is the header row, separator row, and body rows
